about_the_game:
Thank you for supporting development!

Outbreak Island – Supporters Pack is made for those who want to help the continued development of the game and show their appreciation for the team. This DLC does not add gameplay advantages — it’s a symbol of your support for the project.

By purchasing the Supporters Pack, you’ll receive:
An exclusive Supporter Trophy, proudly displayed in your farmhouse — a token of our gratitude.

Your support helps us keep improving Outbreak Island, adding new content, and making the game better for everyone.

Thank you for being part of our journey!

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence, General Mature Content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows® 8.1 / (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 or greater
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible (5.1 surround sound recommended)
  • Additional Notes: Windows-compatible keyboard, mouse
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 / (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or greater
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible (5.1 surround sound recommended)
  • Additional Notes: Windows-compatible keyboard, mouse

short_description: The Supporters Pack is a simple way to show your support for the developer of Outbreak Island! As a thank-you, you’ll receive an exclusive Supporter Trophy displayed in your farmhouse.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
